free.a: You play 3 quizzes for free, without an account. Playing together is always free. If you want all quizzes and the explanation for every answer, you can get Premium.

group.q: How do I start a game for my group?
group.a: Go to Play together, choose Create room and pick a quiz. Share the 6-character code with your group. Up to 20 players join, each on their own phone.

xp.q: How do XP and levels work?
xp.a: You earn XP for every correct answer. With enough XP you go up a level. The leaderboard shows how you are doing, this month and since you started.

translation.q: Which Bible translation do you use?
translation.a: Every answer shows its Bible reference, so you can read the passage yourself.

cancel.a: Via Profile and then Premium. You keep Premium until the end of the period you have already paid for. If you pay through the app, you cancel in the App Store or Google Play.

deleteAccount.q: How do I delete my account?
deleteAccount.a: In the app via your profile, or via {link}. We erase your profile, your progress and your scores. You cannot undo this afterwards.

s1.title: 1. Introduction
s1.text: Welcome to Bible Quizzes. We value your privacy and the protection of your personal data. In this privacy policy we explain which data we collect, why we collect it and how we handle it when you use our app or website.

s2.title: 2. Which data we collect
s2.intro: When you use Bible Quizzes, we may process the following data:
s2.i1: {label} email address, name and profile picture when you sign in through, for example, Google.
s2.i2: {label} scores, completed quizzes and progress, to improve your experience.
s2.i3: {label} for Premium purchases we process status information through our payment provider. We have no access to your card details.

s3.title: 3. How we use your data
s3.intro: We use your data for the following purposes:
items: Saving and syncing progress and results.
Analysing and improving stability and performance.

s4.title: 4. Sharing data with third parties
s4.text: We never sell your personal data to third parties.

s5.title: 5. Data security
s5.text: We take appropriate technical and organisational measures. All communication with our servers is encrypted via HTTPS.

s6.title: 6. Your rights and data deletion
s6.text: You have the right to request access to, correction of or deletion of your data. You can do this through support or through the delete option in your account settings.

s7.title: 7. Cookies
s7.text: On our website we only use functional cookies, for example to keep you signed in during your session.

s8.title: 8. Contact
s8.text: Do you have questions about this privacy policy? Contact us at {email}.

termsPage.title: Terms and Conditions
termsPage.meta: These terms apply to the use of Bible Quizzes and related services.

s1.title: 1. General
s1.text: By using Bible Quizzes you agree to these terms and conditions. These terms apply to all services we offer.

s2.title: 2. Use of the service
s2.text: You may not use other people's accounts or compromise the security of the service. We reserve the right to block accounts in case of misuse.

s3.title: 3. Premium membership
s3.text: Premium membership is entered into by payment. Any cancellation and refund conditions follow the chosen payment model and applicable law.

s4.title: 4. Intellectual property
s4.text: All quiz questions, logos and software are the property of Bible Quizzes. Copying without permission is not allowed.

s5.title: 5. Liability
s5.text: We strive for accuracy, but cannot completely rule out errors in questions or answers. We are not liable for damage resulting from use of the service.

premium.a3: You keep playing for free. Your XP and streak are kept.
